import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    T = data[0]
    N = data[1]
    xs = data[2:2 + N]
    xs.sort()

    ans = float("inf")

    for i, x in enumerate(xs):
        left = 0.0 if i == 0 else (xs[i - 1] + x) / 2.0
        right = float(T) if i == N - 1 else (x + xs[i + 1]) / 2.0
        length = right - left
        if length < ans:
            ans = length

    print(f"{ans:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
